blk.audio-supply.reason: its TPS62840 buck has a switch node, and switch nodes stay in the power zone (floorplan v1 §4 item 6, PCB-A-06)

zone_deltas.reason: The audio zone grows from y -8 to y 2.4 (x < -6.2) on every layer, up to the eMMC's rework clearance: its parts need 1,596 mm2 of courtyard against 1,557 mm2 of floorplan zone on both sides; the core has room

On the front (L1, L2) the audio zone reaches y 14, over the eMMC, which keeps the back and inner layers there (an area may cover only some layers where two zones share a spot on opposite sides, floorplan v1 §2)
The power zone grows from y -8 to y 0 (x > 6.2): the charger's twelve 0805 capacitors (1.25 mm, back only) find no back area outside the battery-contact window otherwise
Top band x -5.5 to 3 moves from the radio zone to the core: the vdd_cpu and vcc3v3_sys inductors (2.1 and 2.0 mm) fit no core band otherwise

The power zone's left edge moves from x 6.2 to x 4.0 between the battery-contact window and y 0: the charger, gauge and VSYS_LV converter passives need it, and the I/O zone keeps x -6.2 to 4.0 (34 % used)
The front of the HAT strip right of the faceplate area moves from the I/O zone to the power zone: the DF40C-50DS sits on the back, its front is free

The back layer of the I/O column's right part above the battery-contact window (x -2 to 4, y -18.8 to -8) moves to the power zone: the charger's twelve 0805 capacitors (1.25 mm) and the VSYS_LV input capacitor are back-only and the power zone's back is full of parts over 1.0 mm; the I/O pairs pass there on L4 and L1

Bottom band above the USB-C (x -6.2 to 6.2, y -36.0 to -28.55) moves from the I/O zone's back layer to the power zone: the fuse, the 5.1 V converter's 1210 and the band inductors exceed the power zone's band
